messages:
morgan: escalation - autorouter routed a customer refund to tax_adjust (acct cust_345). Happened 3x in last hour. Payload + router trace below, customer was partially refunded incorrectly. urgent.

olivia: can you paste request_id, raw payload and env? prod/dedicated?

morgan: prod (us-east-1). request_id=req_01Habc. raw payload (sanitized):
```
{
  "request_id": "req_01Habc",
  "user_id": "cust_345",
  "action": "refund",
  "amount": "$12.50",
  "currency": "USD",
  "lines": [
    { "sku": "ITEM-123", "description": "widget", "amount": "11.25" },
    { "sku": "TAX001", "description": "sales tax", "amount": "$1.25", "type": "tax_line" }
  ],
  "notes": "Customer requested item refund, include tax if applicable"
}
```

morgan: router decision snippet:
```
[router] evaluate tools: create_refund score=0.58, tax_adjust score=0.62
[router] chosen tax_adjust (reason: schema_field_boost on 'tax_line' + currency token detected)
[router.trace] field_matches: 'type:tax_line' -> tax_adjust.schema (boost 0.4)
[router.trace] top_level_action: 'refund' -> create_refund.schema (boost 0.2)
```

support-bot: automated ticket created -> SUP-9876 :rotating_light:

reza: thanks - this smells like the field-name boost for 'tax' is overpowering top-level action. do we have repro steps? can we reproduce locally?

morgan: repro steps I used:
1) curl POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '<payload above>'
2) observe response 200 but invoked tool tax_adjust and changed tax lines

I also tried small variations: amount as number (12.5) -> create_refund chosen; amount as string without $ ("12.50") -> create_refund; amount with leading $ ("$12.50") -> tax_adjust. so the dollar sign seems to influence tokenization and downstream matching.

olivia: can you try adding an explicit "intent": "refund" top-level and see if router respects it? also include full router debug with tokenization if possible.

morgan: quick test: added "intent": "refund" -> router picks create_refund. router debug shows token normalization step flagged currency symbol and gave extra weight to 'tax' tokens when present.

nina: assigning to eng-runtime. @reza will you take lead? suggested mitigations: (1) prefer top-level action/intent as a tie-breaker, (2) normalize amount tokens (strip currency prefixes) before routing, (3) lower schema boost for field name matches that are nested (tax_line). we need a canary rollout.

reza: will implement two changes: normalize amount/tokenize currency to neutral token and add a stronger tie-breaker for explicit intent/action. will ship behind feature flag and canary to 5% traffic. ETA ~3 hours. will open rollout PR and link SUP ticket.

olivia: :thumbsup: please add the repro payload and logs to SUP-9876 and notify affected customer when canary is validated.

morgan: done - added repro case + logs to SUP-9876 and messaged customer with temporary mitigation (use numeric amount without $ or add "intent":"refund"). thanks all.
